title: Confirm your email
subject: Confirm your Pheelm email
message: Confirm your email to finish creating your Pheelm account.

title: Sign in to Pheelm
subject: Your Pheelm sign-in link
message: Use this one-time link to sign in. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

title: Confirm your new email
subject: Confirm your Pheelm email change
message: Confirm this change to the email address used for your Pheelm account. If you did not request it, contact support.

title: Your account was updated
subject: Your Pheelm account email changed
message: Your sign-in email changed. If this was not you, contact Pheelm immediately.

title: Welcome to Pheelm
subject: Welcome to Pheelm
message: Discover films, make collections, and follow directors. Your account is ready.

title: Your account has been deleted
subject: Your Pheelm account has been deleted
message: Your Pheelm account has been deleted. Contact us if you did not request this.

title: We received your film submission
subject: Your film submission is with Pheelm
message: Thank you for helping build the catalog. Your submission is awaiting review; this does not mean it has been published.

title: An update on your submission
subject: An update on your Pheelm submission
message: There is an update on your film submission. Sign in to review its status and any notes.

title: We received your message
subject: Pheelm received your message
message: Thank you for contacting Pheelm. We received your message. Keep this email for your reference.

title: A reply from Pheelm
subject: A reply to your Pheelm message
message: There is a reply to your message.

title: You’re invited to curate
subject: You’re invited to curate a Pheelm collection
message: A Pheelm member invited you to help curate a collection. Sign in to accept or decline.

title: An update on your collaboration
subject: Your Pheelm collection collaboration
message: There is an update on a collection invitation, request, or membership.

title: Confirm your subscription
subject: Confirm your Pheelm newsletter subscription
message: You asked to receive the Pheelm newsletter. Confirm below to subscribe. If this was not you, ignore this email; you will not be subscribed.

title: From Pheelm
subject: Discoveries from Pheelm
message: Films, directors, and collections selected by Pheelm.

title: Your Pheelm activity
subject: Your Pheelm activity digest
message: Here is a summary of recent activity you chose to hear about.

title: An update on your report
subject: Your report to Pheelm
message: We received your report. We review reports against our community guidelines and may be unable to share private moderation details.

title: An update about your content
subject: An important update from Pheelm
message: There is a moderation decision affecting your account or content. You may contact us to ask for a review.

title: An important Pheelm update
subject: An important update about your Pheelm account
message: An important service change affects your use of Pheelm.

title: Your export is ready
subject: Your Pheelm data export is ready
message: The data export you requested is ready. Use your secure download link before it expires.

title: Your Pheelm review queue
subject: Pheelm needs your review
message: Review pending film submissions, reports, and messages in Pheelm.
